from fastmcp.client import Client, FastMCPTransport

    server = FastMCP(name="test-server")

import asyncio
from fastmcp.server import FastMCP
from fastmcp.client import Client, FastMCPTransport


async def main():
    # Create a FastMCP server
    server = FastMCP(name="test-server")

    # Register a resource at "data://config"
    @server.resource("data://config")
    def get_config() -> str:
        return '{"setting": "value", "debug": true}'

    # Create a client with in-memory transport
    client = Client(server)

    # Connect and fetch the resource
    async with client:
        result = await client.read_resource("data://config")
        print("Resource content:")
        print(result)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
